北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京天晴气温低，北风不小，注意保暖防干燥！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels cold with brisk winds. Dress warmly and stay hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪大雾弥漫，风力不小，体感微凉，出行务必注意交通安全！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy with reduced visibility and a cool breeze. Drive carefully and stay safe!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海大雾，能见度低，体感微凉，请您小心驾驶，注意交通安全！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is foggy and feels cool. Drive safely and be mindful of traffic.
上海.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光明媚，温暖宜人，体感舒适，记得做好防晒措施哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and pleasantly warm. Remember your sunscreen today!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光灿烂，温暖舒适，体感超赞！请您注意防晒补水哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and wonderfully warm. Stay hydrated and use sunscreen!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州大雾笼罩，体感凉意，路面湿滑，请您减速慢行，注意安全！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy and feels cool. Roads might be damp, so drive carefully!
杭州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴冷，体感偏低，湿度较大，请注意添衣保暖，防止感冒！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and feels chilly. Remember to dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感舒适，风和日丽，户外活动也要注意适度添衣哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and feels comfortable. Enjoy your day, light layers should be fine!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴冷潮湿，湿度近饱和，请您注意防潮保暖，保持好心情！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, chilly, and extremely humid. Stay warm, dry, and keep a good mood!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴冷，体感偏低，空气极度干燥，请注意补水保湿，多喝水！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and feels cold. It's very dry, so drink plenty of water and moisturize!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感舒适宜人，湿度不低，出门别忘带把伞哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and feels comfortable. It's humid, so consider taking an umbrella.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨天阴极寒，风力不小，请您全副武装，做好保暖防风！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and feels bitterly cold with brisk winds. Bundle up and protect yourself from the wind!
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感冰冷，风力不弱，出门记得多穿，小心感冒！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and feels freezing with a light breeze. Dress very warmly to avoid catching a cold!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光明媚，体感凉爽，紫外线强，出行记得防晒并备外套！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and feels cool. UV is strong, remember sunscreen and a light jacket!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门大雾笼罩，体感暖和，能见度低，出行请注意交通安全哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy and feels warm. Visibility is low, so drive and walk carefully!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴冷，体感偏低，湿度较大，请注意添衣保暖，小心感冒！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels cold. Dress warmly to prevent catching a cold!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感寒冷，北风不小，请您多穿衣，做好防风保暖！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels cold with brisk winds. Dress warmly and protect yourself from the wind!
